title: Josh Allen finally overcame Texans in Houston, leading Bills to dramatic last-minute victory

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Josh Allen finally overcame Texans in Houston, leading Bills to dramatic last-minute victory
sources.description: In a matchup of expected AFC heavyweights, the Bills beat the Texans, 36-31, as Josh Allen and the Bills drove 96 yards in just over 90 seconds to take the lead with 1:36 remaining.
